# GitHub Copilot instructions — ArcadeRecomp

Follow the repository [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) contributor rules.
Before editing code, read [progress/hotd1.json](../progress/hotd1.json),
[docs/PROGRESS_TRACKING.md](../docs/PROGRESS_TRACKING.md) and
[docs/MODEL2C_DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md](../docs/MODEL2C_DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md).

Every change to implementation, tests, tooling or CI requires an evidenced
new progress JSON history entry. If the scope's subjective percentage does
not change, invoke the `review` command. Do not substitute synthetic
status/RX bytes, fabricate hardware timing, declare Gate A/B/C passed,
or confuse green tests with an authentic playable HOTD1 native port.
